title: PayBot
tagline: Discord bot for crypto payments with privy integration: send, receive, refill
description:
Connect through Discord to login and use your wallet directly from your server with your friends!
You can refill your wallet with Privy integration, and use all the basic actions of a crypto payment easily: send, receive, refill via the site and the bot. Basically, you just invite a discord bot in your server and it will allow you to send money easily to your friends.
how_its_made:
This project use a discord bot made in python connected directly to Privy system via our React Webapp in typescript. Privy helped us to create a wallet in 2 seconds for the end user using Discord. The user can link the wallet to many social networks, phone number and much more!
All the communications between Privy and the Discord bot is made through the Privy's API.
